description: Get a policy's full configuration as JSON, or the part at a path: Wi-Fi networks (openNetworkConfigurations), passwords, restrictions, system updates, the launcher, time and geo fences, app configurations and everything else. Secrets read as {"redacted": true}. Use it before propose_policy_change with edits, for anything get_policy_settings doesn't list. Without a path, apps are summarized: read /apps/<packageName> for one app's configuration. lockedFields lists what agents can't change. version (the portal's number) and changedAt say when the policy was last saved.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer to read one part, e.g. /openNetworkConfigurations or /apps/com.example.app/managedConfigurations (an app by package name). Leave out for the whole policy, apps summarized.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

search.description: Optional, when reading /phoneContacts, /libraryFiles or /vr: list only the attachable items whose name or id contains this text.

name: get_policy_document
title: Get policy document
